title: TriMet Transit Centers
description:
Transit Centers. 15 Point features covering [TriMet](https://developer.trimet.org/gis/)'s service district in the Portland, Oregon metropolitan area, published by TriMet as [`tm_tran_cen`](https://developer.trimet.org/gis/data/tm_tran_cen.zip) and last updated at the source on July 31, 2024.

This is a cloud-native mirror: the same data as GeoParquet and PMTiles. The GeoParquet keeps TriMet's native EPSG:2913 (NAD83(HARN) / Oregon North (ft)), so lengths and areas are in feet; only the PMTiles are reprojected to WGS84. The original [Shapefile](https://developer.trimet.org/gis/data/tm_tran_cen.zip), [KML](https://developer.trimet.org/gis/data/tm_tran_cen.kml) and [metadata page](https://developer.trimet.org/gis/meta_tm_tran_cen.shtml) are linked as assets, and column descriptions and code lists are TriMet's own, taken from that page.

The [collection README](https://source.coop/cholmes/trimet/transit-centers/README.md) covers suggested uses, limitations and the full schema.

**Agents:** [`AGENTS.md`](https://source.coop/cholmes/trimet/transit-centers/AGENTS.md) is the guide written for you — what joins to what and on which column, the quirks that produce silently wrong answers (documented codes that do not appear in the data, columns TriMet's metadata omits, counts that mean different things in different collections), what the coordinate system implies for measurement, and query recipes that have each been run against these files.

visual.title: TriMet Transit Centers (PMTiles)
visual.description: Vector tiles for web display, layer name `transit-centers`, reprojected to WGS84 as tiles require. Built with tippecanoe keeping every feature at every zoom, so what a map draws matches the GeoParquet exactly.

thumbnail.title: TriMet Transit Centers preview
thumbnail.description: Rendered from this collection's styles/default.json with MapLibre GL Native, over a light basemap. WebP is allowed for thumbnails by spec PR portolan-sdi/portolan-spec#121, which this catalog targets; Portolan 0.1 alone permits only PNG and JPEG.

style.title: TriMet Transit Centers
style.description: The fifteen transit centers as prominent marks in TriMet brand orange. These are the network's timed-transfer hubs, so they are drawn larger than ordinary stops and stay visible at low zoom.

style-by-county.title: TriMet Transit Centers by county
style-by-county.description: Colors the hubs by COUNTY. TriMet's district spans Multnomah, Washington and Clackamas counties, and this style shows how the transfer hubs are distributed across the three.

style-labeled.title: TriMet Transit Centers with names
style-labeled.description: Transit center marks with NAME shown from zoom 9. Fifteen labels never collide, so this style works as a standalone overview of the network's hub structure.
